OCEAN WORLD AQUARIUM · DOLPHIN TRAINER (Jidda)

Welcome card: WATCH THE DEMO · WALK THE AQUARIUM · PUT ME TO WORK.

Walk: joystick, tap the floor or a tank to walk there, drag to look. Lobby → Shark Tunnel → Exhibit Hall → Dolphin Stadium. Talk to JUNO to start a show.

Show: 1 SIGNAL while the dolphin watches (swipe up = JUMP, down = SPLASH, circle = SPIN, zigzag = WAVE, tap hoop / ball, hold = TAILWALK, up-up = FINALE) · 2 WHISTLE when the ring goes green · 3 FLICK a fish to its mouth, rub its head.

Landscape: open 'Ocean World Aquarium Phone Preview.dc.html' in your pack.
